services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: The Galesburg Community Arts Center is pleased to welcome groups of all ages (pre-K through high school, and beyond) to our space for field trip experiences! While general entry to the Galesburg Community Arts Center gift shop and galleries is always free, guided tours, workshops, interactive activities, and art-making experiences are available for reservation for groups at the rates below. Experiences can easily be tailored to your group’s specific needs and interests, or to align with our rotating exhibition programming. Please consult with us if you have something particular in mind! Field trips may be coordinated with the Arts Center for days when we are not open to the general public
